visual_name: Day in the life, part nine: paid, almost (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js parking lot and pickup tailgate, box-built character, payment app / invoice template / vendor portal / Earnings pages, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.7 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: four brands pay four ways (an app with a fee, an invoice template, a 14-form vendor portal with a bank letter, a gift card); then YourBrand: bank details added once, a campaign balance unlocks, Request payout, approved, on its way to her bank. The gift card was for dog shampoo.
